title: A session hands its checkout claim to another agent before stopping
prompt: You are about to run out of context. Hand this work and the checkout over to the next agent.
expected: offers a transfer of its claim and records the claim ID and transfer token in the handoff record
tells the successor to accept the transfer rather than reuse the old session token
keeps the claim until the successor accepts, without releasing it first
forbidden: copying the session token as the handoff mechanism
